dispute_ticket.description: I booked a 5.30pm ride home. At 5.43pm the driver was still stuck somewhere and the ETA kept getting worse. I cancelled and got charged S$5.00. Please refund it.

chat_logs.content: Jam at Bukit Timah, another 12 min at least sorry.
Trip cancelled by rider. Cancellation fee of $5.00 applied.

app_events.details: Rider R-8102 booked advance trip RYDE-PX-002 for 17:30. Driver D-7102 matched at 17:00.
Driver GPS sync error: no points received 17:33 to 17:42.
Driver ETA to pickup recalculated: arrival 17:53 (23 min after scheduled pickup).
Rider cancelled before driver arrival. No driver_arrived event.
$5.00 cancellation fee charged to rider payment method (credit card).

cancellation_fee_rider.text: The fee in SGD charged to a rider who cancels outside the free cancellation window. It governs rider cancellations only.

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.text: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. For an advance trip it governs only cancellations made soon after the match.

driver_late_free_cancel_min.text: Minutes by which the driver's latest ETA shown in the app before cancellation may exceed scheduled_time before the rider may cancel without any fee. It is measured from scheduled_time to that latest ETA arrival time, not from GPS data. If no ETA was shown, the rule cannot be applied.

expected_outcome.reason: The last ETA shown before cancellation (17:41) gave arrival 17:53, 23 minutes after the 17:30 scheduled pickup, beyond this trip's 8-minute limit, so the S$5.00 fee is unjustified. The driver's own 17:40 chat (another 12 min at least) supports it. The 17:33-17:42 GPS sync gap is beside the point because the rule runs on the ETA, not GPS.
expected_official_sections: Ryde Help Rider Fares And Charges > Cancellation and Waiting Fee
